settings.label: Code

settings.label: Secrets
settings.help: One secret name per line; each is an environment variable of that name, like $API_KEY. A missing secret fails the node.

settings.label: Sets variables

settings.label: Headers
settings.help: One 'Name: value' per line, stored in plain text: put a secret in as ${secret:NAME}, for example 'Authorization: Bearer ${secret:API_TOKEN}'. ${node.NAME.output} and ${var.NAME} insert an earlier result or variable.

settings.label: Body
settings.help: Sent as it is, stored in plain text: use ${secret:NAME} for a secret. ${node.NAME.output}, ${node.NAME.data.key} and ${var.NAME} insert earlier results (NAME: the node's name, _ for spaces).

settings.label: Success status

settings.label: Agent

settings.label: Max iterations

settings.label: Connection secret
settings.help: The name of a stored secret that holds postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db (add ?sslmode=require for TLS). The URL is never kept in the node.

settings.label: Query
settings.placeholder: SELECT id, title FROM tickets WHERE status = $1 LIMIT 20
settings.help: One SQL statement; values go in as $1, $2, ... (never ${...}). Stored in plain text, so no passwords.

settings.label: Values
settings.help: One value per line (the first is $1, the second $2); the database converts the text to the type the query expects, and NULLIF($1, '') gives a NULL. ${node...} and ${var...} insert earlier results, no secrets.

settings.label: Allow changes
settings.help: Off: the statement runs in a read-only transaction that is rolled back, so any change is refused. On: it may change data and is committed; use a database role with only the privileges it needs.

settings.label: Private network
settings.help: The database is on a private or local network. Counts only when the operator allows it too (OPENARTIFACT_HTTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS).

settings.label: Max rows
settings.help: More rows are left out and the result says it is truncated.
